node.statement: For the remainder of node 1 and in particular in the application of lem-maincb-nested-corner-dimension-transport, introduce the local notation P_U^R := Co^A_{P_R}(P_U) and P_V^R := Co^A_{P_R}(P_V). These are definitions, not consequences of def-maincb-partition-state. The latter definition does give A_R=S^A_{P_R}; by def-compressed-corner, Co^A_{P_R} has image S^A_{P_R}=A_R, so the newly defined P_U^R and P_V^R are elements of A_R and the expressions S^{A_R}_{P_U^R,P_V^R} and S^{A_R}_{P_V^R,P_U^R} are well-typed.
